issues.explanation: In 刘备为……之后, 为 means “to be,” not “as.”
Here 中山 is part of the historical title “Prince Jing of Zhongshan,” not a reference to Zhongshan City in the modern sense.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: "Zhongshan"; treat with 靖王 as a historical title

issues.explanation: In this genealogical context, 之后 means “descendant,” not “after.”
Here 曾 is the adverb “once/formerly,” pronounced céng, not the surname Zeng.
Here 从 means “to study under/with” someone, not a dictionary-reference gloss for the character variant.
In 共举大事, 共 means “together,” not “common.”
In 共举大事, 举 means “undertake/carry out,” not merely a character-variant reference.
Here 桃园 refers to the Peach Garden in the story, not Taoyuan City or County in Taiwan.
In 祭天, 祭 means “to sacrifice; make an offering,” not the surname Zhai.
In 祭天, 天 means “Heaven,” not “day.”
In 救国安民, 国 means “country/state,” not the surname Guo.
In 救国安民, 安 means “to bring peace to; pacify,” not the surname An.
Here 民 means “the people,” not a personal name or surname.
In 投在刘焉麾下, 投 means “to join/submit oneself to,” not “to throw.”
Here 在 introduces the position or affiliation “under,” not the existential verb “to exist.”
In 五百人, 百 means “hundred,” not the surname Bai.
In 带刘备、关羽、张飞赴青州, 带 means “to take/bring along,” not “band.”
迎战 is a natural lexical verb meaning “to meet the enemy in battle”; splitting it as 迎 plus 战 hides the useful word.
issues.suggested_fix: Combine with 战 as 迎战, meaning "to meet the enemy in battle"

issues.explanation: Here 往 is a directional preposition/word meaning “toward/to,” not a particle.
In 令他率本部五百人, 令 means “to order/command,” not the unrelated compound reference.
Here 率 means “to lead” and is pronounced shuài, not lǜ.
In 率本部五百人, 本部 means “one’s own troops/unit,” not “headquarters.”
In 五百人, 百 means “hundred,” not the surname Bai.
The historical figure’s name is pronounced Zhū Jùn, not Zhū Juàn.
The phrase means “taking advantage of the strong wind to launch a fire attack”; 风火 is not the natural word grouping here.
issues.suggested_fix: Resegment as 大风 and 火攻, meaning "strong wind" and "fire attack"

issues.explanation: 长社 is a historical place name, not 长 “long” plus 社 “society.”
issues.suggested_fix: Combine with 社 as the place name 长社, pinyin "Chángshè"
